english.title: Assisting offender - indictable offence ( except murder )
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), with intent to impede the apprehension or prosecution of

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY NAME..)]_
(B)_[a person]_

who had committed the offence of **(..SPECIFY THE INDICTABLE OFFENCE - EXCEPT MURDER..) knowing or believing

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_
(E)_[the said person]_

to be guilty of the offence or some other indictable offence for which a term of imprisonment of five years or more may be imposed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(1) and (3) of the Criminal Law Act 1967.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority/reasonable excuse did an act with intent to impede
apprehension/prosecution of person who had committed an indictable offence (except murder)
knowing/believing him/her to be guilty of the offence or some other indictable offence

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required.
(ii) For assisting an offender - eitherway offences see offence wording H2018.
(iii) For assisting an offender (murder only) - see offence wording H2024.

other.powersofarrest:
arrest without warrant

IMPORTANT:
The powers of arrest for offences under section 4(1) require that the offences to which they relate must carry a sentenced fixed by law or one in which a first time offender aged 18 or over could be sentenced to 5 years or more imprisonment.
other.penalty:
Seven years imprisonment if it is an offence for which a person (not previously convicted) may be sentenced to fourteen years imprisonment.

Five years imprisonment if it is an offence for which a person (not previously convicted) may be sentenced to ten years imprisonment.

Three years imprisonment in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
